title: YouTube Automation Manager Update
title_km: ការធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាព YouTube Automation Manager
message: A new version of YouTube Automation Manager is available with the latest features and stability fixes.
message_km: មានកំណែថ្មីនៃ YouTube Automation Manager ជាមួយមុខងារទំនើបៗ និងការជួសជុលប្រព័ន្ធឱ្យកាន់តែមានស្ថេរភាព។
release_notes: Optimized instant tab switching and language transition without window opacity drop
Font typography enhancement: Battambang (Regular & Bold) for Khmer and Segoe UI (Regular & Semibold) for English
Single-Instance Application Lock (prevent multiple instances running simultaneously)
Auto Schedule Date & Time Controls refinement (Full box clickability & no clipping)
